name: inference-engine
description: Evidence-accumulation substrate for the enchanter-ai ecosystem. Runs Wald SPRT + Beta-Binomial + EMA over an append-only artifact stream; elevates patterns that recur across sessions; renders per-plugin briefings consumed at session start. Complements — does not replace — existing per-plugin Gauss-Accumulation-class engines.
